I will also spread manure on this barley field because it keeps the soil fertile and helps the crop during the cool season. I have kept my own barley seed from last year's harvest, so I will use that rather than buy expensive improved seed. My family and I will do all the work ourselves on this 0.19-hectare plot, as it is small enough that we do not need to hire outside labor.
